note: The shape of the evening rather than a timetable. Offsets are minutes from the advertised start so the whole thing moves if the meeting moves, but they render loosely on purpose: a hundred people in a room will drift, and an agenda promising 8:10pm makes everybody late for something. Read by the meeting page and by the slides, so the two cannot disagree.
preamble: Times are approximate and the evening will run how it runs. Two things we will hold to: the floor gets the longest stretch of it, and we finish by about half nine.

rows.why: Come when you can. Nothing formal starts straight away.
